<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--bareos">Bareos</span>

Label a tape.

## Synopsis

```text
label [storage=<storage>] [sd=<sd>] [volume=<volume>] [pool=<pool>]
      [slot=<slot>[,...]] [catalog=<catalog>] [slots=<slots>] [drive=<drive>]
      [barcodes] [barcode] [encrypt] [yes] [device=<device>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Writes a Bareos label onto a new medium (file or tape) through the Storage Daemon and creates the matching Media record in the catalog. Only a labelled volume can be used for backups. The command changes both the medium and the catalog. Missing values are asked for: storage, volume name, slot and pool.

Volume names may contain letters, digits and :.-\_/ but must not start with /. slot= greater than 0 also sets the InChanger flag; on an autochanger without slot= the Director asks for the slot. drive= selects the drive and defaults to 0. encrypt creates a new key for hardware (LTO) encryption and stores it in the catalog.

barcodes labels every volume of an autochanger with the name read from its barcode; slots= restricts this to a slot list such as 1-5,8, and yes answers the confirmation question. Only autochanger storages qualify.

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `storage=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name. |
| `sd=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name (as storage=). |
| `volume=` | string |  |  |  | Volume name. |
| `pool=` | resource | from [`.pools`](../dot-pools/) |  |  | Pool name. |

| `catalog=` | resource | from [`.catalogs`](../dot-catalogs/) |  |  | Catalog name. |
| `slots=` | string |  |  |  | Slots (list or ranges). |
| `drive=` | integer |  |  |  | Drive number. |
| `barcodes` | keyword |  |  |  | Use the barcodes as names. |
| `barcode` | keyword |  |  |  | Use the barcodes as names. |
| `encrypt` | keyword |  |  |  | Encrypt. |
| `yes` | keyword |  |  |  | Do not ask. |
| `device=` | string |  |  |  | Device name. |

## Examples

Label one file volume into pool Full:

```text
label storage=File volume=Full-0001 pool=Full
```

Label slots 1 to 5 with their barcodes, without asking:

```text
label barcodes storage=Autochanger pool=Scratch slots=1-5 yes
```
